# Pinned Seared advancement fixtures

These twenty JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes

Each file is under `{building_blocks,decorations,redstone}/smeltery/seared/`.
The exact group/name mapping is listed in `test_seared_decoration_unlocks.py`
and `docs/seared-decoration-unlocks.md`. `sha256.json` records the source bytes.
